titulo.alumno: A real possibility · Possibility and condition

intro: Part 1: a real possibility. Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

texto: «Hvis» introduces a condition. In an open possibility the present is normally used; in an imagined situation the past can appear with «ville» in the main clause. Pay attention to the context, not only to the verb form.
Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

frases.estudio: Hvis det regner, tager vi bussen.
frases.alumno: If it rains, we take the bus.

frases.estudio: Vi går til stationen, hvis vejret bliver bedre.
frases.alumno: We will go to the station if the weather improves.
